To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the beam lifetime is dominated by the ionisation of the residual gas; the cooling time is inversely proportional to the number of circulating particles; and the electron cooling efficiency is not reduced by neutralization of the electrons.

we have accumulated a beam with a density of 10^9 ions/cm^2, which is the target density for the LHC, and that this density was achieved with a beam lifetime of 10 hours, which is sufficient for a 10-hour LHC injection cycle.
